record.question: The Supreme Court's decision on section 377 of IPC in 2018 has:
options: Allowed LGBTQ couples to legally adopt children provided that unannounced inspections are permitted till the children reach 18 years of age.
Legally permitted LGBTQ to reside together but they will not be allowed to legally marry.
Legally permitted marriage among the LGBTQ but has made no ruling on the issue of divorce.
Made only a small but important foundational change that homosexual acts between consenting adults is now a non-criminal matter.
